about: Field evaluation set (2026-10-04): real requests across many fields and all four tabs, to measure whether field-aware sources help. Labels are human, by the owner, keyed by query and URL (evaluation/field-labels.json); the judge's own score is recorded but never used as the grade. surface: a plain web search should already find good results; deep: the best results usually live on a specialist or official source.
